title: Do State Phone Bans at School Really Improve Student Performance?
text: In recent years, several states have enacted statewide restrictions on student cell phone usage during school hours. This study evaluates the empirical effect of these policies on student academic performance, focusing on standardized test results in states like Louisiana (LEAP 2025 assessments) and South Carolina (SC READY assessments).
